rationale: Windows-first continuation adds a pinned Windows CI/installer path and direct use of already locked sha2/windows-sys packages. Inventory preserves versions, licences and sources; governance now covers the Windows workflow. The unchanged vulnerability thresholds retain the glib advisory with a 30-day candidate renewal based on SECURITY_GLIB_REVIEW_2026-11-25.md. Independent AI reviews are recorded in SECURITY_WINDOWS_NATIVE_REVIEW_2026-11-25.md. approverRole identifies the required CODEOWNERS review role; this draft record does not claim a human approval or authorize release. ARM64 CI retains sanitized system-package diagnostics on failure; the reviewed five-package security inventory change is documented in SECURITY_ARM_INVENTORY_REVIEW_2026-11-25.md and the fail-closed comparison remains unchanged. The existing runtime cache key now follows the reviewed Node 24.22.3 package pin, which contains the upstream Windows namespaced-entrypoint fix; build-tool and isolated-image pins remain separate and unchanged. Windows installer acceptance now authenticates the exact embedded Evergreen payload with reviewed byte/certificate pins and actual Windows trust before execution. Candidate upload requires that verifier result; failed diagnostics remain separately retained. No dependency policy, trust anchor, CSP or packaging mode is relaxed.
